name: para-Camphorene

pubchem.title: alpha-Camphorene
pubchem.description: Alpha-camphorene is a cycloalkene that is cyclohexene substituted by 2-methylpent-2-en-5-yl and 6-methylhepta-1,5-dien-2-yl groups at positions 1 and 4, respectively. It is a diterpene isolated from several plant species. It has a role as a volatile oil component. It is a cycloalkene and a diterpene.

evidence: Measured in 1 of 6 MONDAYS hemp SKUs at 0.07% of total volatiles (0.014mg per chew).

consumer_summary.what_it_is: para-Camphorene is a diterpene, a type of large, volatile molecule that plants use to build their essential oils and resins. As a cycloalkene, it has a complex ring structure that contributes to the unique aromatic profiles of the plants that produce it.
consumer_summary.found_in: It has been identified in the essential oil of Pistacia lentiscus, the Mediterranean shrub famous for producing aromatic mastic resin.
consumer_summary.why_researchers_care: While diterpenes as a class are famous for their diverse biological activities, para-camphorene itself remains a chemical curiosity. Researchers are currently interested in its role as a structural building block in plant volatile oils, though no formal studies have yet investigated its specific effects in humans or animals (Oxford level 5, none found). It represents an untapped area of natural-product chemistry waiting to be explored.
consumer_summary.evidence_at_a_glance: There is currently no published research evaluating the biological or health effects of para-camphorene (Oxford level 5, none found).
